Filling Ingredients 120 g butter of choice (3 sticks) 60 g heavy cream of choice (~1/4 cup) 120 g powdered sugar (1 cup) 20 g light corn syrup (1 tbsp) 1 tbsp vanilla bean paste ⅛ tsp fine sea salt Instructions 1. 🌋Volcán de chocolate  🍫Para la torta:  •150 g mantequilla temperatura ambiente •2 tazas azúcar rubia •2 huevos •3 tazas harina •1 taza cocoa •2 cdtas polvo para hornear •1 cta sal •2 tazas leche •2 ctas esencia de vainilla •1/2 taza aceite Salsa cremosa: •1 lata leche condensada •1 lata leche evaporada •1/3 taza cocoa sin azúcar 👩🏻‍🍳Paso a paso •Paso 1: En un bowl colocamos la mantequilla y el azúcar. Mezclamos hasta que se integren bien. Añadimos los huevos, el aceite y la esencia de vainilla, seguimos mezclando. •Paso 2: En un bowl aparte, mezclamos la harina, la cocoa, la sal y el polvo de hornear. Mezclamos. •Paso 3: Colocamos la mitad de la leche en el bowl de la primera mezcla y mezclamos, luego añadimos poco a poco la mezcla de los ingredientes secos (los pasamos por un colador) y así vamos intercalando la leche con los secos hasta integrar todo muy bien. •Paso 4: Enmantequillamos y enharinamos nuestro molde para keke (tiene que tener un hueco en el centro) y añadimos la mezcla. Llevamos al horno previamente precalentado a 180° por 50 minutos aproximadamente. •Paso 5: Para hacer la crema , colocamos en una olla a fuego medio la leche evaporada con la cocoa y mezclamos. Cuando ya se haya disuelto la cocoa, añadimos la leche condensada y mezclamos constantemente por 25 minutos aproximadamente, hasta que puedas ver el fondo de la olla. •Paso 6: Cuando el keke esté listo, añadimos alrededor y en el centro de nuestro keke la crema y para decorar añadimos la ralladura de chocolate. #reposteras #recetasfaciles #postrespasoapaso #tortadechocolate

Chocolate Molten Lava Cake Ingredients: 4 tbsp unsalted butter, melted 3 oz semisweet chocolate, chopped 1 egg 1 egg yolk 2 tbsp granulated sugar Pinch of salt 1 tbsp flour (I used gluten-free) Directions: Preheat the oven to 450 F In a heat-proof bowl, melt the chocolate and butter over a double boiler, then cool for 5 minutes In a separate bowl, use an electric mixer to mix the egg, egg yolk, sugar, salt, and flour together until it is pale yellow and foamy Add the egg mixture to the chocolate mixture and mix until just combined Bake for 7-8 minutes, until the sides and top are set and the center is jiggly Let cool for 1-2 minutes, then serve upside down on a plate with toppings of choice Enjoy!! #lavacake #chocolatelavacake #trendingfoods #viralrecipes

Vulcão de ninho com Nutella  Ingredientes massa: 4 ovos 1 xícara (chá 250 ml ) de açúcar  200 ml de óleo  1 xícara de leite em pó  1 xícara de água  2 e 1/2 xícaras de farinha de trigo  1 colher (sopa) de fermento químico em pó  Preparo: Coloque no liquidificador todos os ingredientes exceto o trigo e o fermento. Bata por aproximadamente 2 minutos. Acrescente o trigo e o fermento por último e bata rapidamente (no liquidificador mesmo) só para misturar. Passe para forma untada com margarina e eleve para assar em forno pré aquecido, a 180 graus até dourar levemente em cima. Faça o teste do palito para se certificar que está assado corretamente. O tempo de forno é aproximadamente 40 minutos. Desenforme o bolo morno.  Ingredientes cobertura: 1 leite condensado  1 creme de leite  3 colheres (sopa) de leite em pó  Preparo: Coloque todos os ingredientes na panela e leve ao fogo médio, mexendo sempre até ferver. Depois mexa por mais 1 minuto e desligue. Depois de frio é só jogar sobre o bolo e colocar Nutella a gosto.  #campograndems #bolodeninho #receitafácil

Le secret du Gâteau Volcan : Moelleux et irrésistible ! 🌋🍫. 1.La base : Battre les œufs avec le sucre et la vanille jusqu’à ce que le mélange blanchisse. 2.Les liquides : Ajouter l’huile tout en continuant de battre, puis verser le lait. 3.Le secret de la texture : Incorporer la farine (environ 300g) petit à petit. Attention : la quantité peut varier selon la qualité de votre farine (certaines absorbent plus que d’autres !). 4.La touche finale : Ajouter le cacao et la levure chimique en même temps que la farine. 5.	Le montage : Verser la pâte dans un moule de 27 cm de diamètre, puis déposer délicatement au centre la crème pâtissière maison. 6.	La cuisson : Enfourner à 180°C pendant 40 minutes. Allumer uniquement le bas au début, puis le haut en fin de cuisson pour dorer. 7.	La déco : Une touche de zeste de citron et du chocolat râpé pour le contraste des saveurs. 🍋🍫 Bon appétit ! ❤️ #GâteauVolcan #CakeChocolat #PatisserieMaison #RecetteFacile

Molten Chocolate Lava Cake  Ingredients: - 1/2 cup unsalted butter - 6oz semi-sweet or bittersweet chocolate, chopped - 2 large eggs - 2 large egg yolks - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 1/4 cup sugar - 1/4 tsp salt - 2 tbsp flour - 1 tsp espresso powder Bake at 450 F for 8-10 minutes in ramekins Makes 4-6 servings (depends on ramekin size) Instructions: Grease your ramekins well and dust  them with a little flour or cocoa powder. Melt the butter and  chopped chocolate together until  completely smooth over a double boiler. Or you can do this in the microwave in  short intervals, stirring between each one. In a separate bowl, whisk together  the eggs, egg yolks, sugar, vanilla, and  salt. Whisk until everything is smooth  and slightly thicker and lighter in color. The extra egg yolks help give the lava  cake a richer, more custardy center. Add the flour and espresso powder into chocolate mixture, and mix just until  combined. The espresso powder isn’t there to  make it taste like coffee—it just helps  enhance the chocolate flavor.  Slowly pour the melted chocolate mixture  into the egg mixture and whisk until  smooth, but make sure not to overmix. Divide the batter evenly between  four to six ramekins, depending on  their size. Bake at 450°F for about 8 to 10 minutes. The edges should be set, but the centers  should still look slightly soft and jiggly. And this is where you really don’t want  to overbake them. Let them rest for a minute, then carefully  flip them onto a plate. #chocolate #cake #dessert #easyrecipe #easydessert

Chocolate Volcano Cake Ingredients: 200g dark chocolate (70%) 150g butter 150g sugar 3 eggs 100g flour 25g cocoa powder 8g vanilla sugar 2g salt 3-4g baking powder (optional, for a fluffier texture) Preparation: Melting Chocolate and Butter Break the chocolate into pieces, mix it with butter, and melt over a double boiler or in the microwave (in short 20-second intervals, stirring in between). Making the Batter In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs with sugar and vanilla sugar until light and fluffy. Pour in the melted chocolate and butter mixture, then stir well. Sift in the flour, cocoa powder, salt, and baking powder (if using). Mix gently. Baking Preheat the oven to 170°C. Pour the batter into a 20cm round cake tin lined with parchment paper. Bake for 20-25 minutes. The cake should remain slightly moist inside (check with a toothpick—it should come out slightly sticky). Cooling and Serving Let the cake cool completely in the tin. Optionally, dust with powdered sugar or serve with a scoop of ice cream and caramel. Enjoy! 🍫🎂 #cake #easyrecipe #cupcakes #foodlover #brownies #chocolate #dessert #foodtok #fyp #cookie
